messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway.prod in us-west-2. 5m error rate: 18% (baseline 0.5%). Paging rota: @sre_oncall.

sre_oncall: on it. pulling up dashboards and traces. do we have a recent deploy or config roll?

alex: saw a weight shuffle on the LB ~4m ago from infra-deploy-bot, moved significant traffic to cluster `inference-b-2026`. could be related.

maya: checking envoy metrics for that cluster. summary: 502/503 spike, connection failures, and a sharp increase in upstream reset_count. looks like clients hit overloaded upstreams and retries amplified.

ben: quick customer note: we already have a handful of errors grouped in Crashlytics from customer xyz - they're seeing 504s for /v1/stream calls.

sre_oncall: ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) remove weight from new cluster (drain) 2) disable cross-cluster retries at gateway 3) increase circuit-breaker thresholds for the old cluster while we investigate.

alex: running lbctl now to set weights back. command: `lbctl set-route-weight inference-gateway / -> inference-b-2026 0`

infra-deploy-bot: executed weight change. previous weight 0.45 -> 0.0 for inference-b-2026. propagation expected < 20s.

maya: disabling retries at the gateway route: past config used `retry_policy: retry_on: 5xx,connect,retriable-status-codes` — sending hotpatch to remove retry_on for that route. patch applied.

sre_oncall: posting the hotpatch we applied: ```yaml
# applied via envoy config hotpatch
- match: { prefix: "/v1/" }
  route:
    retry_policy: null
```

ben: monitoring shows error rate decreasing from 18% -> 6% over the last minute, customer impact reduced but still elevated. propagate to customers? product-ops wants a short note.

product-ops: yes please a 1-2 line update: affected endpoints, mitigation steps taken, ETA for full resolution.

alex: quick root-cause hypothesis: the weight change exposed an instance group with a mis-tuned circuit-breaker (low max_connections + aggressive retriable policies) causing rapid connection exhaustion -> upstream 5xx, retries cascading. traces show KV cache miss bursts and more cold-starts on that cluster.

maya: digging logs on the misbehaving cluster, found repeated envoy logs: `upstream reset: connection failure` and `resource exhausted` on the connection pool. snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T03:12:21Z] envoy warn upstream reset: code=RST_STREAM, reason=exceeded_pool
[2026-03-15T03:12:23Z] envoy error resource exhausted: max_connections reached
```

sre_oncall: next steps: 1) keep weight at 0 for inference-b-2026 (drained) 2) revert retry policy globally for gateway to conservative defaults 3) Eng-platform to inspect cluster autoscaling + cb config 4) follow-up postmortem if quota/capacity misconfiguration found. Assigning owners: alex (LB rollback), maya (hotpatch + metrics), ben (customer comms), eng-platform (investigate cluster config).

alex: leaving the thread to hand off to eng-platform. I will keep the emergency rollback documented: `rollback-id: lb-weight-6177777000` in deploy log.

eng-platform (via infra-deploy-bot): acknowledged — will run `kubectl scale` and audit envoy cluster config next. please share suspected node pool or launch template id.

ben: customer-ops message drafted: "We experienced elevated 5xx/504 errors impacting streaming endpoints in us-west-2 between 03:10-03:32 UTC. We rolled back a routing weight change and applied a temporary retry hotpatch which reduced errors. Engineers are investigating root cause; we will follow up with a detailed timeline and impact." send?

product-ops: send now. include link to incident thread and status page.

maya: marking incident as P1 and creating an incident ticket with initial notes and logs. collecting a sample trace id: trace-0b3f8a2 for further analysis.

sre_oncall: closing live paging loop for now — error rate back to ~0.8% and routing stable after drain + hotpatch. eng-platform please continue with deep-dive. I'll update the incident ticket with mitigation timeline and handoff notes. :white_check_mark: 

product-ops: thanks. will prepare customer-facing follow-up after eng-platform root-cause.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation_applied=true, severity=P1, current_error_rate=0.8%, owners=[alex,maya,ben,eng-platform].
